the_signal.headline: Multi-agent memory now beats coordination—Bedrock AgentCore ships
the_signal.body: Amazon's AgentCore lets you build triage agents that route to specialists while maintaining shared customer context across all four agents. This solves the hard problem: not just spinning up agents, but giving them persistent memory and task routing without coordination failures. For GTM, this means your lead scoring, enrichment, and qualification agents can finally work together on the same customer thread without hallucinating contradictory decisions.

tool_drop.name: Argentic

thread_of_day.title: RPA vs. Workflow Automation: Building Automation That Lasts
thread_of_day.takeaway: Workflow automation with native async APIs scales and observes better than RPA; enterprises are replacing UiPath with event-driven systems because they can't debug or scale bot farms.

quote.text: All four [agents] run on a single Amazon Bedrock Agent [core]—multi-agent teams that remember every customer
quote.source: n8n Blog, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore post

whats_moving.context: Bedrock AgentCore shipping persistent context across multi-agent teams forces every GTM platform to solve customer memory; stateless agents are now a liability.
Argentic's L402 toll booth model shows the market is commoditizing per-action costs; GTM teams need to track agent spend the way they track API calls.
n8n's authentication explainer signals that key/token sprawl is becoming a compliance blocker; GTM automation stacks need centralized auth management.

act_on_this: Audit your multi-agent workflows this week—map which agents touch customer data and identify where memory/context is being lost between handoffs. Use that map to evaluate Bedrock AgentCore or equivalent platforms.

numbers.stat: Three specialist agents + one router agent = single Bedrock AgentCore instance (vs. four separate deployments with coordination failures)
numbers.context: Consolidation from four failure points to one unified system is the inflection point where multi-agent GTM stops being experimental and becomes operational.
